versions_note: Sec. 13 #2: for the methods below 98%, the version with the highest parse rate was taken (WiC para1 v2 0.85, para2 v2 0.70, WiC hard negative v1 0.955, NLI hard negative v1 0.605). (iv) uses the template of A.

parse_definition.choice: Greedy output (up to 8 new tokens; WiC sense choice 4) equals exactly one candidate after lm.normalize (strip spaces, quotes and trailing punctuation; lowercase).
parse_definition.wic_generation: One non-empty line, not cut by the token limit, the original word form exactly once (case-insensitive whole word), not identical to the source sentence; [[ ]] markers are removed before counting.
parse_definition.nli_paraphrase: One non-empty line, not cut by the token limit, different from the source text.
parse_definition.nli_hardneg: One line whose word edit distance to the hypothesis is exactly 1.
parse_definition.atoms: At least one bullet line, not cut by the token limit; at most 8 atoms are kept.
parse_definition.wic_iii_step1: Both glosses '1: ...' and '2: ...' found (each truncated to 32 tokens).

nli_m_note: Sec. 5: mean prompts of A per item on MNLI train 200 = 1 + 3.46 atoms = 4.46, rounded (qwen_run2).

check.pool_note: WiC pairs are drawn from WiC dev and test together; NLI from ChaosNLI-S and -M together.

b_len_definition: 1{yhat = d} + premise tokens / (max premise tokens + 1), one score per direction d of (b-yhat); tokens counted with the roberta tokenizer without special tokens. The Sec. 8 rule is applied if the lower end is <= 0 for any direction.
